properties.english_form: MASTER signals [STB_O] and [CYC_O] MUST be negated at the rising [CLK_I] edge following the assertion of [RST_I], and MUST stay in the negated state until the rising [CLK_I] edge that follows the negation of [RST_I].
properties.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge CLK_I) ($rose(RST_I)) |=> (!STB_O && !CYC_O)); assert property (@(posedge CLK_I) (RST_I) |-> (!STB_O && !CYC_O));

properties.english_form: [RST_I] MUST be asserted for at least one complete clock cycle on all WISHBONE interfaces.
properties.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge CLK_I) ($rose(RST_I)) |=> RST_I);

properties.english_form: All WISHBONE interface signals MUST use active HIGH logic.
properties.sva_form: // Static structural check: no signal in the wishbone interface declared as active LOW (e.g. no #RST_I / /RST_I / N_RST_I naming).

properties.english_form: MASTER [CYC_O] MUST be asserted no later than the rising [CLK_I] edge that qualifies the assertion of [STB_O], and MUST be negated no earlier than the rising [CLK_I] edge that qualifies the negation of [STB_O].
properties.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge CLK_I) ($rose(STB_O)) |-> CYC_O); assert property (@(posedge CLK_I) ($fell(STB_O)) |-> CYC_O || $past(CYC_O));

properties.english_form: SLAVE interfaces MAY NOT respond to any SLAVE signals when [CYC_I] is negated. SLAVE interfaces MUST always respond to SYSCON signals.
properties.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge CLK_I) (!CYC_I) |-> (!ACK_O && !ERR_O && !RTY_O));

properties.english_form: In standard mode the cycle termination signals [ACK_O], [ERR_O], and [RTY_O] MUST be generated in response to the logical AND of [CYC_I] and [STB_I].
properties.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge CLK_I) (ACK_O || ERR_O || RTY_O) |-> (CYC_I && STB_I));

properties.english_form: If a SLAVE supports the [ERR_O] or [RTY_O] signals, then the SLAVE MUST NOT assert more than one of the following signals at any time: [ACK_O], [ERR_O] or [RTY_O].
properties.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge CLK_I) ((ACK_O + ERR_O + RTY_O) <= 1));

properties.english_form: As a minimum, the MASTER interface MUST include the following signals: [ACK_I], [CLK_I], [CYC_O], [RST_I], and [STB_O].
properties.sva_form: // Static structural check on the interface declaration.

properties.english_form: As a minimum, the SLAVE interface MUST include the following signals: [ACK_O], [CLK_I], [CYC_I], [STB_I], and [RST_I].
properties.sva_form: // Static structural check on the interface declaration.

properties.english_form: SLAVE interfaces MUST be designed so that the [ACK_O], [ERR_O], and [RTY_O] signals are asserted and negated in response to the assertion and negation of [STB_I].
properties.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge CLK_I) ($fell(STB_I)) |=> (!ACK_O && !ERR_O && !RTY_O));

properties.english_form: MASTER interfaces MUST be designed to operate normally when the SLAVE interface holds [ACK_I] in the asserted state.
properties.sva_form: // Coverage point — random sustained ACK_I=1 stimulus.

properties.english_form: MASTER interfaces MUST qualify the following signals with [STB_O]: [ADR_O], [DAT_O()], [SEL_O()], [WE_O], and [TAGN_O].
properties.sva_form: // All STB_O-qualified signals must be valid when STB_O=1; their values during STB_O=0 are don't-care.

properties.english_form: SLAVE interfaces MUST qualify the following signals with [ACK_O], [ERR_O], or [RTY_O]: [DAT_O()].
properties.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge CLK_I) (ACK_O || ERR_O || RTY_O) |-> $stable(DAT_O));

properties.english_form: All user defined tags MUST be assigned a TAG TYPE. Furthermore, they MUST adhere to the timing specifications given in this document for the indicated TAG TYPE.
properties.sva_form: // DATASHEET cross-check + temporal: TGA qualified by STB; TGD_I qualified by STB; TGD_O qualified by STB; TGC qualified by CYC.

properties.english_form: All MASTER and SLAVE interfaces that support SINGLE READ or SINGLE WRITE cycles MUST conform to the timing requirements given in sections 3.2.1 and 3.2.2 (READ) / 3.2.3 and 3.2.4 (WRITE).
properties.sva_form: // Cover the Figure 3-5 / 3-6 / 3-7 sequences.

properties.english_form: All MASTER and SLAVE interfaces that support BLOCK cycles MUST conform to the timing requirements given in sections 3.3.1 and 3.3.2.
properties.sva_form: // CYC_O remains asserted across all STB_O pulses within the block.

properties.english_form: All MASTER and SLAVE interfaces that support RMW cycles MUST conform to the timing requirements given in section 3.4.
properties.sva_form: // CYC_O remains asserted across both READ and WRITE halves.

properties.english_form: Data organization on each port size (64 / 32 / 16 / 8 bit) MUST conform to Figures 3-18 / 3-19 / 3-20 / 3-21 respectively, for both BIG and LITTLE ENDIAN.
properties.sva_form: // SEL_O() byte-lane mapping check vs declared port_size + granularity + endianness.

properties.english_form: All WISHBONE Registered Feedback compatible cores MUST support WISHBONE Classic bus cycles.
properties.sva_form: // Static structural + simulation: when CTI_I=3'b000, slave behaves as Classic.

properties.english_form: MASTER and SLAVE interfaces that do support [CTI_I()] and [CTI_O()] signals MUST at least support the Classic cycle [CTI_IO()=3'b000] and the End-of-Cycle [CTI_IO()=3'b111].
properties.sva_form: // Simulation: cover CTI_IO()=000 and CTI_IO()=111; observe correct behavior.

properties.english_form: MASTER and SLAVE interfaces that are designed to support a limited number of burst types MUST complete the unsupported cycles as though they were WISHBONE Classic cycle, i.e. [CTI_IO()=3'b000].
properties.sva_form: // Behavioral check: unsupported CTI -> Classic semantics.

properties.english_form: A cycle terminates when both the cycle termination signal and [STB_I], [STB_O] is asserted. Even if [ACK_O], [ACK_I] is asserted, the other signals are only valid when [STB_O], [STB_I] is also asserted.
properties.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge CLK_I) (ACK_I) |-> $past(STB_O));

properties.english_form: MASTER and SLAVE interfaces that support incrementing burst cycles MUST support the [BTE_O()] and [BTE_I()] signals.
properties.sva_form: // Static structural check: presence of BTE on the interface.

properties.english_form: A MASTER MUST set End-Of-Burst on [CTI_O()] to signal the end of the current burst (CTI_O()=3'b111).
properties.sva_form: // Behavioral check: last STB_O of a burst overlaps CTI_O=3'b111.

properties.english_form: A MASTER signaling a constant address burst MUST initiate another cycle; the next cycle MUST be the same operation (either read or write), [SEL_O()] MUST have the same value, and [ADR_O()] MUST have the same value.
properties.sva_form: // Beat-tracker: within the burst, WE_O, SEL_O, ADR_O stay constant.

properties.english_form: A MASTER signaling an incrementing burst MUST initiate another cycle; the next cycle MUST be the same operation (either read or write), [SEL_O()] MUST have the same value, [ADR_O()] MUST be incremented, and the wrap size MUST be set by the burst type extension [BTE_O()] signals.
properties.sva_form: // Beat-tracker: within the burst, WE_O, SEL_O, BTE_O stay constant; ADR_O follows Table 4-3 sequence per BTE_O wrap mode.

properties.english_form: RECOMMENDATION 3.10 — Design INTERCON modules to prevent deadlock conditions; a watchdog timer monitoring MASTER [STB_O] asserts [ERR_I] or [RTY_I] if a cycle exceeds the time limit.
properties.sva_form: // Liveness / response-bound check: STB_O asserted for > T cycles without termination -> INTERCON injects ERR_I/RTY_I.

properties.english_form: RECOMMENDATION 3.15 — design WISHBONE MASTER interfaces so that there are no intermediate logic gates between a registered flip-flop and the signal outputs on [STB_O] and [CYC_O].
properties.sva_form: // Static structural / synthesis-aware check.

evidence.quote: Combined RULEs and RECOMMENDATIONs governing reset behavior (3.00 / 3.05 / 3.15 / 3.20), CYC_O assertion ordering (3.25), SLAVE response to CYC_I (3.30), handshake AND-rule (3.35), at-most-one termination (3.45), minimum interface signals (3.40), and STB_O qualification (3.60).
All WISHBONE interface signals MUST use active high logic.

Combined RULEs governing Registered Feedback bus cycles: Classic must be supported (4.00); minimum Classic + End-of-Cycle support (4.05); unsupported burst falls back to Classic (4.10); cycle terminates when ACK + STB both asserted (4.15); BTE required for incrementing burst (4.20); End-of-Burst is mandatory (4.30); constant-address-burst requirements (4.35); incrementing burst requirements (4.40).
